add.title: World Report 2025: Mali — Human Rights Watch
add.summary: Thin: no usable prison-housing finding. The HRW World Report 2025 Mali chapter (Events of 2024) covers the junta's rule, counterterrorism sweeps (arbitrary arrest of 25 people in Ouro Fero village, Nara region) and an ICC arrest warrant, but contains no transgender-specific content and no information on prison placement, special units, or solitary/segregation practice for trans prisoners.
